newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Fannie Mae, Freddie Mac are buys.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Fannie Mae, Freddie Mac are buys.

text.p: -- Salomon Brothers said analyst Jeffrey Naschek started coverage of Federal National Mortgage Association (Fannie Mae) and Federal Home Loan Mortgage Corp (Freddie Mac) with buy ratings
-- Analyst says without burden of branch networks or costly origination and servicing operations, agencies "have been able to swing market share in their favor for several years."
-- Analyst estimates Fannie Mae will earn $2.80/shr in '97, $3.15 in '98; Freddie Mac estimates are $1.90/shr in '97, $2.20 in '98
